invoice.title: Invoice center
invoice.needProfile: Select a profile. Special invoices require address, phone, bank and account details.
invoice.notice: After payment and information checks, manual issuance takes about 1–2 business days. Invoices are emailed to the saved address.
invoice.closed: Issued orders cannot be requested again. For corrections or other issues contact WeChat: {wechat}
invoice.disabled: Invoice requests are currently unavailable. Contact support.
invoice.profileHint: Save multiple companies. Billing name and tax ID must match the actual buyer; special invoices require full bank and address details.
invoice.specialFields: Required for special invoices; optional for standard invoices.
invoice.deleteConfirm: Delete this profile? Existing request snapshots remain unchanged.
invoice.loadFailed: Could not load data. Please retry.
invoice.saveFailed: Operation failed. Check the information or retry.
invoice.paidOnly: Only your paid, non-refunded, uninvoiced orders are eligible. Orders must have the same currency and billing identity.
invoice.noSelection: Select orders and a billing profile first.
invoice.exTax: Prices exclude tax. The configured rate applies to the selected invoice type.
invoice.profileMissing: Add a billing profile to continue.
invoice.confirmSent: I manually issued and emailed this invoice to the address above
invoice.adminHint: Only paid requests can be processed. Send the invoice manually, enter its number and confirm. Issued orders cannot be invoiced twice.
